# VAT codes (MWST-Codes)

<!-- Generated by `npm run vat-codes` from src/accounting/vat-codes.ts and the English UI texts. Do not edit. -->

Every journal entry carries a VAT code from the code list of Banana Accounting. The code says which boxes of the VAT return the amount goes to and whether the amount includes the tax. The boxes shown here come from the same calculation as the return.

The app shows the same catalogue in German, French, Italian and English: MWST tab, **Codes erklärt**, or a
click on any code. There each code also lists the entries of the period that use it.

## How to read a code

- **The letters** name the family: V sale, VS discount on a sale, F flat tax rate, B acquisition tax,
  M material and goods, I investments and operating costs, K corrections, Z money that is no consideration.
- **The digits** are the rate times ten: 81 is 8.1%, 26 is 2.6%, 38 is 3.8%. 77, 25 and 37 are the rates until 2023.
- **A minus** in front (-V81, -I81) makes a refund or reversal: the same boxes, and the amount counts negative.
- **No suffix** on a code with a rate: the amount includes VAT, and the code takes the tax out of it.
- **-1** after an input-tax or acquisition-tax code: the amount excludes VAT, and the tax is computed on top of it.
- **-2**: the amount is the VAT itself, booked as a single-leg entry without a contra account.
- **-B, -E, -N, -T, -D** on a sale code name the kind of supply (opted, abroad, not taxable, notification procedure, various).
- **Boxes (Ziffern)** are the numbers of the ESTV return (form 0550). "turnover" means the gross amount counts in the box,
  "taxable" that it is taxable turnover whose tax the rate row computes, "tax" that only the VAT in the amount counts.
  The boxes below are what the app's engine books (`vat().report` over modules/ch), proven by tests/vat-codes.test.ts.
- **Not declared**: the app puts the code into no box. Banana would; the column names Banana's boxes.

The rules that choose a code are in `processes/booking.guide.yaml` (purchase_vat, sale_vat, side, eigenverbrauch);
worked cases are in the [casebook](casebook.md).

## V: Sales

### Tax-exempt supply, mainly exported goods

**When:** Goods leave the country and the export is documented (customs document, proof of shipping, Art. 23 MWSTG). The amount counts as turnover in box 200 and is deducted again in 220; no tax.

**Not when:** Services to customers abroad: V0-E (box 221). Goods that stay in Switzerland: V81.

**Rules:** `sv-order-tax`

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V0 | Von der Steuer befreite Leistungen, u.a. Exporte (220) | 0% | gross | 200 (turnover), 220 (turnover) | [Webshop order shipped abroad (export, Ziffer 220)](../examples/cases/webshop-export.yaml) |

### Supply abroad

**When:** A service to a customer based abroad: the place of supply is the recipient’s (Art. 8 para. 1 MWSTG). Box 200 and deducted in 221; no tax.

**Not when:** Exported goods: V0 (box 220). Services whose place the law sets otherwise (real estate, passenger transport, restaurants, events: Art. 8 para. 2).

**Rules:** `sv-service-abroad`

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V0-E | Leistungen im Ausland (221) | 0% | gross | 200 (turnover), 221 (turnover) | [Consulting fee paid by a client abroad (Ziffer 221)](../examples/cases/consulting-revenue-abroad.yaml) |

### Transfer under the notification procedure

**When:** A business or a part of it goes to another taxable person and is reported on form 764 instead of being taxed (Art. 38 MWSTG). Box 200 and deducted in 225.

**Not when:** Selling single pieces of equipment outside a business transfer: V81.

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V0-T | Übertragung im Meldeverfahren (225) | 0% | gross | 200 (turnover), 225 (turnover) |  |

### Supply excluded from tax

**When:** A supply that Art. 21 MWSTG excludes from tax: renting without option, insurance, financial services, medical treatment, education. Box 200 and deducted in 230. Input tax on costs for it cannot be deducted.

**Not when:** Exports (V0) and supplies abroad (V0-E). Money with nothing in return (donations, dividends): Z0.

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V0-N | Nicht steuerbare Leistungen (230) | 0% | gross | 200 (turnover), 230 (turnover) |  |

### Various deductions from turnover

**When:** An amount in box 200 that is not taxable and fits no other deduction, for example the value of the land when a property is sold. Box 200 and deducted in 280.

**Not when:** Exports (V0), supplies abroad (V0-E), excluded supplies (V0-N). When in doubt, ask your fiduciary.

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V0-D | Diverses (280) | 0% | gross | 200 (turnover), 280 (turnover) |  |

### Opted supply (taxed by choice)

**When:** A supply the law excludes from tax, such as renting to a business tenant, is taxed by choice under Art. 22 MWSTG and invoiced with VAT.

**Not when:** Ordinary taxable sales: V81. Without the option the supply stays excluded: V0-N.

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V77-B | Verkauf und Dienstleistungen 7.7% (optiert) | 7.7% standard rate (until 2023) | gross | not declared (Banana: 200, 205, 302) |  |
| V81-B | Verkauf und Dienstleistungen 8.1% (optiert) | 8.1% standard rate | gross | not declared (Banana: 200, 205, 303) |  |

### Sale or service in Switzerland with VAT

**When:** A customer pays an invoice or order that shows Swiss VAT at this rate. Book the amount paid, VAT included; the code takes the tax out. On cash basis the tax belongs to the quarter the money arrives in.

**Not when:** A customer abroad (a service: V0-E, goods exported: V0). An invoice without VAT. A refund to a customer: the same code with a minus.

**Rules:** `sv-order-tax`, `sid-sale-refund`

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V77 | Verkauf und Dienstleistungen 7.7% | 7.7% standard rate (until 2023) | gross | 200 (turnover), 302 (taxable) |  |
| V81 | Verkauf und Dienstleistungen 8.1% | 8.1% standard rate | gross | 200 (turnover), 303 (taxable) | [Consulting fee paid by a Swiss client (8.1%)](../examples/cases/consulting-revenue-ch.yaml) |
| V25-N | Verkauf und Dienstleistungen 2.5% | 2.5% reduced rate (until 2023) | gross | 200 (turnover), 312 (taxable) |  |
| V26 | Verkauf und Dienstleistungen 2.6% | 2.6% reduced rate | gross | 200 (turnover), 313 (taxable) |  |
| V37 | Verkauf und Dienstleistungen 3.7% | 3.7% accommodation rate (until 2023) | gross | 200 (turnover), 342 (taxable) |  |
| V38 | Verkauf und Dienstleistungen 3.8% | 3.8% accommodation rate | gross | 200 (turnover), 343 (taxable) |  |

## VS: Discounts on sales

### Reduction of consideration (cash discount, rebate) on a sale

**When:** In Banana, a customer’s cash discount or rebate reduces the turnover in box 235.

**Not when:** This app does not declare VS codes. On cash basis the amount actually paid is booked with the sale code; a repayment with the sale code and a minus (-V81).

## B: Acquisition tax (reverse charge)

### Acquisition tax: a service from abroad without Swiss VAT

**When:** A supplier abroad that is not in the Swiss VAT register provides a service (software, advertising, consulting) without Swiss VAT. The company owes the tax itself (box 382/383) and deducts it again as input tax in the same entry (405): net zero. From the first franc (Art. 45 MWSTG).

**Not when:** Goods from abroad (import VAT covers them). Foreign suppliers that charge Swiss VAT: I81. Excluded services such as payment processing.

**Rules:** `pv-bezugsteuer`

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B77 | Bezugsteuer 7.7% (inklusive MwSt/USt) | 7.7% standard rate (until 2023) | gross | 382 (tax), 405 (tax) |  |
| B77-1 | Bezugsteuer 7.7% (exklusive MwSt/USt) | 7.7% standard rate (until 2023) | net | 382 (tax), 405 (tax) |  |
| B77-2 | Bezugsteuer 7.7% (MwSt/USt-Betrag) | 7.7% standard rate (until 2023) | the VAT | 382 (tax), 405 (tax) |  |
| B81 | Bezugsteuer 8.1% (inklusive MwSt/USt) | 8.1% standard rate | gross | 383 (tax), 405 (tax) |  |
| B81-1 | Bezugsteuer 8.1% (exklusive MwSt/USt) | 8.1% standard rate | net | 383 (tax), 405 (tax) | [Software subscription from abroad without Swiss VAT (Bezugsteuer)](../examples/cases/bezugsteuer-foreign-service.yaml) |
| B81-2 | Bezugsteuer 8.1% (MwSt/USt-Betrag) | 8.1% standard rate | the VAT | 383 (tax), 405 (tax) |  |

## M: Input tax on material and services

### Cost without deductible Swiss VAT

**When:** No receipt, a receipt without Swiss VAT (supplier abroad or not registered, 0%), or an excluded supply such as rent, insurance, bank fees. The entry goes into no box.

**Not when:** The receipt shows Swiss VAT with rate and amount: I81 or M81. A service from abroad without VAT: B81-1. A CHE number alone does not prove VAT.

**Rules:** `pv-no-receipt`, `pv-che-but-zero`, `pv-otherwise`

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M0 | Befreite Material- und Dienstleistungsaufwand | 0% | gross | none | [Courier customs bill with import VAT (eVV)](../examples/cases/import-vat-evv.yaml) |

### Input tax on material, goods and services

**When:** The receipt shows Swiss VAT at this rate, and the cost is material, goods for resale or their freight and customs (accounts 4xxx). The tax in the amount is input tax in box 400.

**Not when:** Operating costs and purchases of equipment (accounts 1xxx, 5xxx–6xxx): an I code. No receipt with Swiss VAT: M0. The letter follows the account, not the supplier.

**Rules:** `pv-charged`, `pv-prefix-from-account`, `pv-import-vat-evv`

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| M77-2 | Material- und Dienstleistungsaufwand 7.7% (MwSt/USt-Betrag) | 7.7% standard rate (until 2023) | the VAT | 400 (tax) |  |
| M81 | Material- und Dienstleistungsaufwand 8.1% (inklusive MwSt/USt) | 8.1% standard rate | gross | 400 (tax) | [Courier customs bill with import VAT (eVV)](../examples/cases/import-vat-evv.yaml) |
| M81-1 | Material- und Dienstleistungsaufwand 8.1% (exklusive MwSt/USt) | 8.1% standard rate | net | 400 (tax) |  |
| M81-2 | Material- und Dienstleistungsaufwand 8.1% (MwSt/USt-Betrag) | 8.1% standard rate | the VAT | 400 (tax) | [Monthly input tax on webshop fees (single-leg M81-2)](../examples/cases/webshop-fees-vat.yaml) |

## I: Input tax on investments and operating costs

### Cost without deductible Swiss VAT

**When:** No receipt, a receipt without Swiss VAT (supplier abroad or not registered, 0%), or an excluded supply such as rent, insurance, bank fees. The entry goes into no box.

**Not when:** The receipt shows Swiss VAT with rate and amount: I81 or M81. A service from abroad without VAT: B81-1. A CHE number alone does not prove VAT.

**Rules:** `pv-no-receipt`, `pv-che-but-zero`, `pv-otherwise`

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| I0 | Befreite Investition und Betriebsaufwand | 0% | gross | none | [Pension fund (BVG) premium](../examples/cases/bvg-premium.yaml) |

### Input tax on investments and other operating costs

**When:** The receipt shows Swiss VAT at this rate, and the cost is an operating cost or a purchase of equipment (accounts 1xxx, 5xxx–6xxx). The tax in the amount is input tax in box 405.

**Not when:** Material and goods (accounts 4xxx): an M code. No receipt with Swiss VAT: I0. The letter follows the account, not the supplier.

**Rules:** `pv-charged`, `pv-prefix-from-account`

## K: Corrections and reductions

### Subsequent input tax deduction (Einlageentsteuerung)

**When:** Something bought without deducting input tax (before VAT registration, or for an excluded activity) is now used for taxable supplies: the input tax on its current value is deducted afterwards (Art. 32 MWSTG). Box 410.

**Not when:** Ordinary purchases with a VAT receipt: I81 or M81.

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| K77-A | Einlageentsteuerung 7.7% (410) | 7.7% standard rate (until 2023) | gross | 410 (tax) |  |
| K81-A | Einlageentsteuerung 8.1% (410) | 8.1% standard rate | gross | 410 (tax) |  |

### Input tax correction (private share, own use)

**When:** A cost whose input tax was deducted in full is partly private (phone plan, laptop, car). The private share moves to the owner’s current account, and the code gives back the input tax on it (Art. 31 MWSTG). Box 415 reduces the input tax.

**Not when:** A purchase that is wholly private: do not book it as a cost, or reverse it with the minus code (-I81). A reduction for subsidies: K81-C.

**Rules:** `eig-entry`

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| K77-B | Vorsteuerkorrekturen 7.7% (415) | 7.7% standard rate (until 2023) | gross | 415 (tax) |  |
| K81-B | Vorsteuerkorrekturen 8.1% (415) | 8.1% standard rate | gross | 415 (tax) | [Private share of a mixed-use expense (Vorsteuerkorrektur)](../examples/cases/private-share.yaml) |

### Input tax reduction

**When:** The company receives subsidies or similar public contributions (Art. 18 para. 2 let. a–c MWSTG); the input tax is reduced in proportion (Art. 33). Box 420 reduces the input tax.

**Not when:** A private share: K81-B. Donations and dividends do not reduce the input tax.

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| K77-C | Vorsteuerkürzungen 7.7% (420) | 7.7% standard rate (until 2023) | gross | 420 (tax) |  |
| K81-C | Vorsteuerkürzungen 8.1% (420) | 8.1% standard rate | gross | 420 (tax) |  |

### Tax credit on form 1050 or 1055

**When:** Only when settling with flat tax rates: a tax credited with the ESTV’s form 1050 or 1055 (box 470/471).

**Not when:** This app files with the effective method and does not declare these codes.

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1050 | Steueranrechnung gemäss Formular Nr. 1050 |  | the VAT | not declared (Banana: 470) |  |
| F1055 | Steueranrechnung gemäss Formular Nr. 1055 |  | the VAT | not declared (Banana: 471) |  |

## Z: Money that is no consideration

### Subsidies and other public contributions

**When:** The company receives subsidies, tourist taxes, waste or water utility contributions (Art. 18 para. 2 let. a–c MWSTG). Box 900; the input tax is reduced (K81-C).

**Not when:** Payment for a supply: a V code. Donations and dividends: Z0.

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Z0-A | Subventionen, durch Kurvereine eingenommene Tourismusabgaben, Entsorgungs-und Wasserwerkbeiträge (Bst. a-c) |  | gross | not declared (Banana: 900) |  |

### No consideration: donations, dividends, damages

**When:** Money for which the company supplies nothing: donations, dividends, damages (Art. 18 para. 2 let. d–l MWSTG). Box 910.

**Not when:** Paid invoices for a supply: a V code. Loans and contributions of the owner need no VAT code.

| Code | Banana text | Rate | Amount is | Boxes | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Z0 | Spenden, Dividenden, Schadenersatz usw. |  | gross | not declared (Banana: 910) |  |
